changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RollupPath') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[RollupPath]( [Uid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [ScoreType] int not null, [State] int NOT NULL, [PathHash] varchar(50) not null, --[Path] as metrics.CalculateRollupPathWrapper(Uid), CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricRollupPath] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) ) END
